title: Act: Add describeRoundError, empty mapping and retry to App
summary: Refactor App round loading into a reusable loader with error mapping and retry
description: Implement loadRound, describeRoundError and wire onRetry to HeaderOverlay. Product code only.
acceptance_criteria: 404 sets no error and no round
Other ApiError sets error to 'Round service returned <status>' plus detail when present
TypeError sets 'Could not reach the server'
Retry resets loading and error and reloads

steps.action: Add exported function describeRoundError(e: unknown): string returning `Round service returned ${e.status}` plus `: ${e.detail}` if present for ApiError, 'Could not reach the server' for TypeError, otherwise 'Round request failed'.
steps.expected: Function maps each error kind to a message

steps.action: Replace the effect body with a useCallback loadRound that sets loading true and clears roundError, calls getCurrentRound, sets round on success, on ApiError status 404 sets round undefined without error, otherwise sets roundError via describeRoundError, and finally sets loading false. Call loadRound from useEffect.
steps.expected: Initial load and retry share one code path
